name: Ghost Ladder
tagline: The command center for the next generation of competitive coaching businesses.
positioning: Ghost Ladder turns solo esports coaches into scalable academies — scheduling, VOD review, and rank tracking in one brutal, focused platform.

hero.h1: Build the coaching empire the ladder deserves.
hero.sub: You are not a hobbyist. Ghost Ladder gives owner-operator coaches the scheduling, VOD breakdown, and rank-progression engine to run a real academy — not a Discord.

features.title: VOD Review Timeline
features.description: Drop a replay, drop timestamped notes, and export a frame-annotated breakdown your player actually rewatches. No more screen-share amnesia.

features.title: Rank Trajectory Engine
features.description: Track every player from Silver to Radiant with rank deltas, win-rate curves, and the exact drills that moved the needle this week.

features.title: Seat-Based Scheduling
features.description: Assign coaches to seats, auto-fill availability across time zones, and stop double-booking your Tuesday scrim block forever.

features.title: Drill Playbook Library
features.description: Codify your aim routines, comms scripts, and map calls into reusable playbooks so every coach on your roster teaches the same doctrine.

features.title: Roster Command View
features.description: See every client, session, and unpaid invoice on one screen — the single pane of glass your spreadsheet was never going to become.

features.title: Session Recording Vault
features.description: Every coaching call archived, transcribed, and searchable. Prove your value at renewal with receipts, not vibes.

testimonials.quote: I went from coaching 6 Valorant players out of a notes app to running a 40-seat academy. Ghost Ladder is the operating system I didn't know I was allowed to want.
testimonials.name: Devon Marsh

testimonials.quote: The rank trajectory reports sell themselves. Parents renew because they can literally see the climb. My churn dropped in half in one season.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: We used to lose an hour per client just scheduling around EU and NA scrims. Seat-based scheduling gave me back my mornings and my sanity.
testimonials.name: Lukas Vogel

pricing.blurb: For the one-person operation ready to look like a real business.
For growing rosters running multiple coaches under one banner.
For multi-region academies and org-backed programs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ghost Ladder is the command center for esports coaching businesses that intend to win. Built for owner-operators. Priced per seat.
